","fetch maximum batch ID to determine what's the most current batch and categorize it as NEW
","whilst PAST shows errors from previous batches that have not been handled yet
","*/
","
","with maxBatchId as (
","  select
","    max(batchId) maxBatchId
","  from cfg_sch.cfg_error_log
","  where reprocessedDatetime is null
",")
","select
","  log.batchId
","  , log.sourceTable
","  , array_join(collect_set(log.errorDescription), ' | ') as listErrors
","  , count(distinct log.sourceRowId) as countFailedRows
","  , CASE
","      WHEN log.batchID = any_value(max.maxBatchId)
","      THEN 'NEW'
","      ELSE 'PAST'
","    END batchStatus
","    -- just need this to show as a KPI
","  , RANK() over(order by count(distinct log.sourceRowId) desc) as rank
","from cfg_sch.cfg_error_log log
","inner join maxBatchId max
","  on 1=1
","where
","  log.reprocessedDatetime is null
","group by
","  log.batchId
","  , log.sourceTable
","order by
","  batchStatus
","  , log.batchID
","  , log.sourceTable
